title: OperatingLine Blender action catalog
description: Allowlisted deterministic Blender actions implemented by the OperatingLine 0.1 Companion.
planningNotes: Use only actions present in this catalog; arbitrary Python, bpy expressions, screen coordinates, and unlisted Blender operators are unsupported.
Create resources before actions that read or mutate them, and encode those relationships with dependsOn.
Every objectName, materialName, sceneName, worldName, and dataName must start with OperatingLine. so the adapter never overwrites user-named resources.
The adapter keeps the legacy internal logical collection id snowman.collection for catalog replay compatibility, but presents it as a generic OperatingLine-generated collection for every goal.

The catalog can construct scenes from individual planes, cubes, UV spheres, Icospheres, cones, cylinders, and tori or bounded primitive batches; make bounded whole-mesh Subdivide and Triangulate edits; extrude one explicit edge-connected face region by a fixed local-space translation; add owned Bevel and Solidify modifiers; create an owned Transform Geometry node group; assign Principled materials; create and bind a rigid armature; bind explicit normalized deform weights through an Armature modifier; author pose transform keyframes with bounded interpolation; create an isolated scene; add Area lights and a camera; and render a managed PNG preview at a selected frame. Triangulate and Extrude Region require Object Mode, no modifiers or shape keys, and source and result topology within 8192 vertices, 16384 edges, and 8192 polygons. Triangulate additionally requires at least one non-triangle polygon and fixes quad_method=FIXED and ngon_method=EAR_CLIP. Extrude Region accepts 1..256 unique polygon indices that must form one edge-connected region with a boundary edge and applies one nonzero local-space translation with length in 0.0001..1000. Solidify requires every existing target modifier to be receipt-tracked and limits both source and evaluated input to the same topology bounds; solidify_mode=EXTRUDE, use_even_offset=true, use_rim=true, and use_rim_only=false are fixed implementation behavior rather than action parameters. Prefer one meaningful operation per leaf. Sculpting, arbitrary vertex or edge selection, disjoint face regions, automatic weights, arbitrary modifiers, and arbitrary node graphs remain explicit actionless/manual nodes.
Use semantic anchors and supported observations to explain and verify every executable leaf. Do not invent a pixel location for a Blender menu item.
Organize executable leaves under ordered root-level phase groups and call operatingline.planning.evaluate before proposing the complete plan.

planningPhases.title: Geometry
planningPhases.description: Create and refine the model with bounded primitives, mesh edits, modifiers, and Geometry Nodes.
planningPhases.selectionGuidance: Select for every object-building goal; create owned geometry before any edit, modifier, or node action that targets it.

planningPhases.title: Materials
planningPhases.description: Create and assign visible Principled material properties to owned model parts.
planningPhases.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal specifies appearance, color, roughness, or metallic response.

planningPhases.title: Rig and animation
planningPhases.description: Create a bounded armature, optional explicit deform weights, and pose transform keyframes for owned parts.
planningPhases.selectionGuidance: Select only when the goal requests motion or a reusable pose. Use explicit skin weights only for bounded meshes; automatic weights remain unsupported.

planningPhases.title: Render setup
planningPhases.description: Create an isolated scene, world, lighting, and camera for the owned collection.
planningPhases.selectionGuidance: Select before output whenever the goal asks for a rendered preview or controlled presentation.

planningPhases.title: Output
planningPhases.description: Render a managed PNG preview from the prepared scene.
planningPhases.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal asks for an image result; render_setup must also be selected.

semanticCapabilities.title: Ground plane
semanticCapabilities.description: Create an owned planar surface that grounds the visible assembly.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal needs a floor, stage, or other flat supporting surface.

semanticCapabilities.title: Primitive assembly
semanticCapabilities.description: Construct an owned model from supported cube, UV-sphere, Icosphere, cone, cylinder, and torus primitives.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the requested form can be represented by individual supported primitives or an intentionally atomic bounded batch.

semanticCapabilities.title: Bounded Edit Mode subdivision
semanticCapabilities.description: Replace an owned object's mesh data with one deterministic whole-mesh subdivision result.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal needs uniformly denser topology before later modifiers or deformation.

semanticCapabilities.title: Bounded Edit Mode triangulation
semanticCapabilities.description: Replace an owned object's mesh data with one deterministic whole-mesh triangulation result.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal requires explicit triangle topology before later export, deformation, or rendering work.

semanticCapabilities.title: Bounded Edit Mode region extrusion
semanticCapabilities.description: Replace an owned object's mesh data with one deterministic extrusion of an explicit edge-connected face region.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal requires extending one known face region by an explicit local-space translation.

semanticCapabilities.title: Bevel modifier
semanticCapabilities.description: Add one owned, parameterized Bevel modifier to an earlier mesh object.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the requested form needs nondestructive rounded edges.

semanticCapabilities.title: Solidify modifier
semanticCapabilities.description: Add one owned, parameterized Solidify modifier to an earlier mesh object within the bounded topology limit.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the requested form needs nondestructive wall thickness from an existing surface.

semanticCapabilities.title: Geometry Nodes transform
semanticCapabilities.description: Create one owned Transform Geometry node group and attach it through a Geometry Nodes modifier.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal benefits from an inspectable procedural translation, rotation, or scale stage.

semanticCapabilities.title: Principled material palette
semanticCapabilities.description: Create and assign owned Principled materials with explicit visible surface properties.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal specifies color, roughness, metallic response, or a reusable material palette.

semanticCapabilities.title: Rigid armature
semanticCapabilities.description: Create and bind an owned rigid armature for supported object parts.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when owned parts need a reusable rigid hierarchy for posing or animation.

semanticCapabilities.title: Explicit deform skin weights
semanticCapabilities.description: Bind every vertex of an owned bounded mesh to an owned armature with normalized explicit weights and an Armature modifier.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal needs inspectable mesh deformation and the provider can declare complete per-vertex weights; never infer or auto-generate weights.

semanticCapabilities.title: Pose transform keyframes
semanticCapabilities.description: Author explicit rotation plus optional location and scale keyframes for an owned armature with bounded interpolation.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal requests bounded rigid or deform motion at named frames.

semanticCapabilities.title: Render scene setup
semanticCapabilities.description: Prepare an isolated owned render scene with world, lighting, camera, and collection linkage.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select before rendered output whenever the goal needs controlled presentation.

semanticCapabilities.title: PNG preview output
semanticCapabilities.description: Render a managed PNG preview artifact from the prepared scene.
semanticCapabilities.selectionGuidance: Select when the goal asks for a rendered image or preview artifact.

actions.name: blender.mesh.edit_subdivide
actions.title: Subdivide one owned mesh
actions.description: Creates a bounded whole-mesh subdivision result and swaps it onto an earlier owned mesh object without mutating the source mesh datablock.

targetId.description: Logical ID of an owned mesh object created by an earlier action.

resultMeshId.description: Plan-unique logical ID for the replacement mesh datablock.

cuts.description: Uniform cuts applied to every edge; bounded to control topology growth.

resourceEffects.description: Swaps the owned object's mesh link to the generated result.
Creates the bounded subdivided mesh while retaining the source for compensation.

actions.name: blender.mesh.edit_triangulate
actions.title: Triangulate one owned mesh
actions.description: Creates a bounded whole-mesh triangulation result with fixed FIXED/EAR_CLIP methods and swaps it onto an earlier owned mesh object without mutating the source mesh datablock. The target must be in Object Mode, have no modifiers or shape keys, contain at least one non-triangle polygon, and remain within 8192 vertices, 16384 edges, and 8192 polygons.

targetId.description: Logical ID of an owned mesh object created by an earlier action.

resultMeshId.description: Plan-unique logical ID for the replacement triangulated mesh datablock.

resourceEffects.description: Swaps the owned object's mesh link to the generated triangulation result.
Creates the bounded triangulated mesh while retaining the source for compensation.

actions.name: blender.mesh.edit_extrude_region
actions.title: Extrude one owned mesh face region
actions.description: Creates a bounded face-region extrusion result and swaps it onto an earlier owned mesh object without mutating the source mesh datablock. The target must be in Object Mode with no modifiers or shape keys. polygonIndices must name one edge-connected region with a boundary edge; translation is a nonzero local-space vector. Source and result topology stay within 8192 vertices, 16384 edges, and 8192 polygons.

targetId.description: Logical ID of an owned mesh object created by an earlier action.

resultMeshId.description: Plan-unique logical ID for the replacement extruded mesh datablock.

polygonIndices.description: Unique source polygon indices forming one edge-connected region with at least one boundary edge.

translation.description: Local-space translation vector whose Euclidean length must be between 0.0001 and 1000 at execution.

resourceEffects.description: Swaps the owned object's mesh link to the generated extrusion result.
Creates the bounded extruded mesh while retaining the source for compensation.

actions.name: blender.modifier.add_bevel
actions.title: Add one Bevel modifier
actions.description: Adds one owned, bounded Bevel modifier to an earlier owned mesh object without applying it.

resourceEffects.description: Adds a non-applied modifier to the owned target's stack.
Creates one receipt-owned Bevel modifier.

actions.name: blender.modifier.add_solidify
actions.title: Add one Solidify modifier
actions.description: Adds one owned, bounded Solidify modifier to an earlier owned mesh object without applying it. Every existing modifier must be receipt-tracked, and both source and evaluated input must have at most 8192 vertices, 16384 edges, and 8192 polygons. solidify_mode=EXTRUDE, use_even_offset=true, use_rim=true, and use_rim_only=false are fixed implementation behavior.

resourceEffects.description: Adds a non-applied Solidify modifier after receipt-tracked modifiers only; both source and evaluated input are limited to 8192 vertices, 16384 edges, and 8192 polygons, with solidify_mode=EXTRUDE, use_even_offset=true, use_rim=true, and use_rim_only=false fixed by the implementation.
Creates one receipt-owned Solidify modifier.

actions.name: blender.geometry_nodes.create_transform
actions.title: Create one Transform Geometry node group
actions.description: Creates an owned Geometry Nodes group containing one Transform Geometry node and attaches it through one owned modifier.

resourceEffects.description: Adds the Geometry Nodes modifier to the owned target.
Creates one receipt-owned Geometry Nodes modifier.
Creates one owned Transform Geometry node tree.

actions.name: blender.material.create_and_assign
actions.title: Create and assign one material
actions.description: Creates one owned Principled material and replaces material slots on 1 to 64 previously created owned mesh objects.

targets.description: Logical IDs of owned mesh objects created by earlier actions.

resourceEffects.description: Creates one owned material.
Replaces the material slots of existing owned mesh targets with compare-and-restore rollback.

actions.name: blender.material.create_palette_and_assign
actions.title: Create and assign a material palette
actions.description: Atomically creates 1 to 8 owned Principled materials and assigns each target at most once.

materials.description: materialId, materialName, and all targets must be unique across the palette.

resourceEffects.description: Creates every palette material atomically.
Assigns the palette to previously created owned mesh objects.

actions.name: blender.rig.create_armature
actions.title: Create and bind a rigid armature
actions.description: Creates one owned armature with 1 to 32 bones and bone-parents previously created unparented owned objects while preserving their world transforms.

bones.description: Bone head and tail must differ; every non-null parentName must reference another bone without forming a cycle.

bindings.description: Each target must be an owned unparented object and each boneName must exist in bones.

resourceEffects.description: Requires the tracked adapter-managed collection.
Requires previously created owned, unparented objects.
Creates the armature object and armatureId.data datablock.
Bone-parents the targets with compare-and-restore rollback.

actions.name: blender.rig.bind_skin_weights
actions.title: Bind explicit armature skin weights
actions.description: Creates normalized vertex groups for every vertex of one owned bounded mesh and attaches an owned Armature modifier to a previously created owned armature.

preserveVolume.description: Enables Blender's preserve-volume deformation on the owned Armature modifier.

influences.description: Bone names must be unique and weights must sum to 1 for this vertex.

weights.description: Must contain every mesh vertex index exactly once. Automatic, partial, negative, or non-normalized weights are rejected at execution.

resourceEffects.description: Requires one previously created owned, unparented mesh with at most 8192 vertices.
Requires one previously created owned armature containing every referenced bone.
Creates exact per-bone vertex groups and records their complete bounded assignment state.
Adds one owned Armature modifier and enables deformation only on the referenced bones.

actions.name: blender.animation.create_pose_keyframes
actions.title: Create armature pose transform keyframes
actions.description: Creates one owned Action and inserts bounded Euler-rotation plus optional location and scale keyframes on bones of a previously created owned armature.

interpolation.description: Optional interpolation applied to every authored keyframe; defaults to BEZIER.

extrapolation.description: Optional FCurve extrapolation applied to every authored channel; defaults to CONSTANT.

location.description: Optional pose-bone local translation keyed at this frame.

scale.description: Optional positive pose-bone local scale keyed at this frame.

resourceEffects.description: Requires an owned armature created by an earlier catalog action.
Creates one owned Blender Action datablock.
Assigns the owned action and inserts bounded pose transforms with explicit interpolation and compensating rollback.

actions.name: blender.render_scene.create

actions.name: blender.render_rig.create
actions.title: Create Area lights and a camera

lights.description: Resource IDs, object names, and data names must be unique; location must differ from target.

resourceEffects.description: Requires an isolated scene created by an earlier catalog action.
Requires the managed collection linked into the scene.
Creates Area light objects and resourceId.data datablocks.
Creates and activates the camera and its resourceId.data datablock.

actions.name: blender.render.execute_preview
actions.title: Render a managed PNG preview
actions.description: Renders an existing owned scene to a PNG under the extension-managed temporary directory.

resourceEffects.description: Requires an owned scene with an active camera.
Creates a digest-tracked PNG only inside the managed temporary output root.
